items.title: Measure the Earthquake Intelligence MVP
items.hypothesis: A useful live earthquake intelligence tool will generate more search visibility, engagement, and repeat visits than the previous summary-only event page.
items.successMetric: Primary: Search Console impressions and clicks. Secondary: engaged visits, repeat visits, earthquake interactions, and USGS source clicks over at least 14 days.
items.rollbackPlan: Restore the summary-only event treatment if the tool introduces correctness or usability regressions; do not claim significance from low-volume samples.
items.notes: Pre-release baseline captured 2026-09-03: GA4 reported 2 pageviews and 1 visit for the route in the 7-day merged window. The 29-day Search Console page snapshot contained no row for this route, which means no reported route-level search data rather than a confirmed numeric zero. Begin the 14-day measurement window only after supervised deployment.

items.title: Expand the first space-events landing pages
items.hypothesis: Dedicated launch and NASA live pages should outperform generic homepage cards for repeat visits and watch-clicks.
items.successMetric: Higher watch-click rate and repeat sessions from space pages over 28 days.
items.rollbackPlan: Freeze generation for weak topics and remove low-performing internal links.
items.notes: Human review required before enabling new page templates in production.
